'''Shannon Caine''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Mystic Visions tournament (first event)]] on 5 May 2001 with [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|MKOS/Gallid]] and [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS/Harvest]], according to Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2236">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-05-mystic-visions-columbia-pa-5-5-01d2236/ mystic-visions-columbia-pa-5-5-01], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 5 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-05-mystic-visions-columbia-pa-5-5-01d2236/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
